taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said your training left you poorly prepared. What is happening?

My training was just one slide deck and my buddy is swamped with month-end, so I learned invoice posting from YouTube. Last week I posted three invoices to the wrong cost centre and had to reverse them, so a two-hour hands-on SAP session with real cases would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: Inadequate onboarding training and an unavailable buddy led to self-teaching invoice posting from YouTube and subsequent errors. [ONBOARDING_TRAINING] "My training was just one slide deck and my buddy is swamped with month-end, so I learned invoice posting from YouTube."
